usda-wood.title: USDA Forest Service, Wood Handbook: Wood as an Engineering Material (2021)
usda-wood.notes: Chapters 4–9, 13, 17: moisture, strength, fastening, beam equations and framing

awc-wfcm.title: American Wood Council, 2024 Wood Frame Construction Manual (WFCM)
awc-wfcm.notes: Committee-developed ANSI standard covers connections, floors, walls, and roofs in limited one- and two-family dwelling designs; scope and local adoption must be checked

usda-drying.title: Richard Bergman (2021), Drying and Control of Moisture Content and Dimensional Changes, USDA Wood Handbook Chapter 13
usda-drying.notes: Moisture content, equilibrium, shrinkage and storage

pnnl-loadpath.title: PNNL Building America Solution Center, Continuous Load Path from Roof Through Wall to Foundation
pnnl-loadpath.notes: Gravity and lateral loads, openings, headers and connectors; cites FEMA P-804

awc-span-tutorial.title: American Wood Council, Tutorial for Understanding Loads and Using Span Tables
awc-span-tutorial.notes: Floor and roof load paths, stiffness, joist/rafter span assumptions and deflection

rammer-fastenings.title: Douglas R. Rammer, Fastenings, Wood Handbook ch. 8, USDA Forest Service Forest Products Laboratory (2010)
rammer-fastenings.notes: Wood connections, nails, screws, lateral and withdrawal capacity, joist hangers
